_methodology.pricePerPerson: sourced: true = found a specific current price/range. sourced: false = estimated from comparable tours, verify before finalizing.

Every wikipediaTitle below was verified to return a working thumbnail as of lastUpdated.
_methodology.structuralNote: Unlike Turkey, Madeira is a single base (Funchal) with day trips radiating out - there is no destination-hopping/flight-between-stops. Activities are grouped by 'zone' (Funchal City, Monte, West Coast, Central Mountains, Sea) rather than by separate destinations.

activities.name: Zona Velha (Old Town) self-guided walk
activities.description: Painted door project, Mercado dos Lavradores market, cathedral, harbourfront - Funchal's compact historic core, all walkable.

activities.name: Cable car + Monte toboggan + Botanical Garden (guided combo)
activities.description: Scenic cable car up from Funchal seafront to Monte, a walk through Monte Palace Tropical Garden, then the famous wicker toboggan ride back down the hill steered by two 'carreiros' in straw hats - Madeira's signature activity.

activities.name: DIY: cable car + toboggan only (no guide)
activities.description: Same core experience without a guide or gardens - cable car return plus toboggan run, booked separately and self-timed.

activities.name: West coast guided day tour (Câmara de Lobos, Cabo Girão, Ribeira Brava, Porto Moniz)
activities.description: Full loop of the south/west coast highlights in one day - fishing village, Europe's highest sea-cliff skywalk, and the volcanic natural swimming pools at Porto Moniz.

activities.name: Cabo Girão Skywalk (self-drive/bus)
activities.description: Glass-floored viewing platform 580m above the Atlantic - free most of the year, with an occasional nominal fee in peak season. Reachable by bus 7/142 from Funchal (~30min) or as part of a west coast tour.

activities.name: Porto Moniz natural volcanic pools
activities.description: Seawater pools formed in cooled lava rock, on the island's northwest tip - a swim rather than a sightseeing stop.
activities.sourceNote: Estimated municipal pool entrance fee - not directly confirmed.

activities.name: Guided levada walk (25 Fontes or similar)
activities.description: Walk alongside one of Madeira's centuries-old irrigation channels through laurel forest to a waterfall - the island's defining hiking experience, easier grade suitable for most fitness levels.
activities.sourceNote: Estimated from comparable small-group guided walk pricing - no single confirmed operator/price found.

activities.name: Pico do Arieiro to Pico Ruivo ridge hike
activities.description: Madeira's headline trail - steep stone paths and tunnels along a dramatic mountain ridge, often done at sunrise. More demanding than the levada walks; transfers usually included.
activities.sourceNote: Estimated from comparable full-day guided hike/transfer pricing - not directly confirmed.

activities.name: Whale & dolphin watching catamaran
activities.description: Half-day catamaran trip along the south coast - Madeira's waters host around 28 cetacean species including sperm whales and several dolphin species. Most operators offer a free repeat trip if nothing is spotted.

activities.name: Madeira wine tasting (Blandy's Wine Lodge or similar)
activities.description: Tasting and short tour of a historic Funchal wine lodge - Madeira's fortified wine has been made on the island since the 15th century.
activities.sourceNote: Estimated from typical fortified-wine-lodge tasting pricing - not directly confirmed for a specific Funchal lodge.
